name: Pymunk
role: Python 2D rigid-body physics engine with fixed-step simulation
notes: 2026-11-15: Triage: assess; manual fixed-step Python simulation offers a distinct bake route beside the JavaScript physics tools. Revisit after an owned fixture checks state serialization and repeatability.
2026-11-15: Skill opportunity: no standalone skill yet; consider a VCR toolkit guide only if a reproducible fixed-step simulation fixture is adopted.
summary: Python binding to the Chipmunk 2D rigid-body engine, driven through simulation spaces, bodies and constraints. It supports fixed-step updates and serializable spaces, offering a Python bake route distinct from JavaScript-first physics libraries; deterministic behavior still depends on callbacks and environment.
use_when: Bake repeatable 2D rigid-body motion from Python using a fixed step
Use Chipmunk constraints and collision callbacks in a Python pipeline
avoid_when: Use Rapier when you need a maintained cross-platform 2D/3D physics engine with bindings
Use Matter.js when the scene and physics are already browser-based

assessment.rationale: Pymunk 7.3.1 was released 2026-10-11; official documentation describes fixed-step simulation and pickle support. MIT Python bindings to Chipmunk; repeatability across callbacks, versions and machines remains unverified.
